description: Awarding Contracts of Ground Handling Services for Sri Lankan Airlines at the Frankfurt Airport (FRA) in Germany
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The contract of Passenger and Ramp Handling Services for Sri Lankan Airlines at the Frankfurt Airport (FRA) in Germany has expired on 2025-10-31 and the contract of the Cargo Warehouse Handling Services is due to expire on 2025-12-31. Bids have been invited following the Limited International Competitive Procurement method to select suitable service providers who have the capability of providing passenger, ramp and cargo warehouse handling services for SriLankan Airlines at that Airport. 06 bids have been received for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation to award the said contracts as follows, based on the recommendations of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet:to award the contract of Passenger and Ramp Handling Services to Fraport Ground Services GmbH, the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder, at an estimated cost of EUR 6.49, for a period of 03 years (from 2025-11-01 to 2028-10-31).to award the contract of Cargo Warehouse Handling Services to CHI Aviation Handling GmbH, the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder, at an estimated cost of EUR 947,766 for a period of 03 years (from 2026-01-01 to 2028-12-31).
